title: Fragment-Level Graph Encoding for Interpretable Molecular Property Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.29589v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are among the standard tools for molecular property prediction, but the atom-level explanations of their predictions are hard for medicinal chemists to act on. We propose a change of input representation rather than a new model: molecules are encoded as fragment-level graphs from BRICS decomposition, where each node is a synthetically meaningful fragment whose features are the element-wise sum of its atoms' features. Because only the representation changes, any message-passing GNN and any post-hoc attribution method produces explanations at the resolution of functional groups instead of single atoms. Across four architectures, four prediction tasks, and two explainers under scaffold splits, fragment-level encoding matches atom-level test accuracy on roughly five-fold smaller graphs. translated_title: 基于片段级图编码的可解释分子性质预测
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）是分子性质预测的标准工具之一，但其预测的原子级解释对药物化学家而言难以直接采用。我们提出改变输入表示而非设计新模型：将分子通过BRICS分解编码为片段级图，其中每个节点是一个具有合成意义的片段，其特征为其原子特征的逐元素求和。由于仅改变了表示方式，任何消息传递GNN和任何事后归因方法都能在功能团分辨率而非单个原子的层面上产生解释。在骨架划分下，跨越四种架构、四个预测任务和两种解释器的实验表明，片段级编码在约五分之一大小的图上达到了与原子级相同的测试精度。积分梯度归因在两个酶靶点上以高于随机水平的准确率恢复了已知药效团，其中在BACE上达到1.5倍的……
tldr: 该论文提出用BRICS分解将分子编码为片段级图取代原子级图，在不改变模型结构的前提下使GNN能够给出功能团级别的可解释预测，并在约五分之一大小的图上达到与原子级编码相当的预测精度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes encoding molecules as fragment-level graphs via BRICS decomposition instead of atom-level graphs, enabling any GNN to produce functional-group-resolution explanations without model changes, while matching atom-level accuracy on roughly five-fold smaller graphs.
